description:
Level up your charisma in the fastest way possible: https://bit.ly/CU-2425

For the first time in history we have professional conversation havers - they’re called podcasters.  And one of the most overlooked social skills that make them successful - is the ability to connect with anyone, even when they have nothing in common.

So in this video, I’ll show you 6 techniques - that the best conversationalists use, and that you can use today - to connect with anyone and begin a more meaningful relationship.


0:00 - Intro
0:29 - #1: Let them know this
2:03 - #2: Navigate the talk towards...
3:49  - #3: Parroting
4:34 - #4:  Advocate for things people...
6:32 - #5: Pause and take a moment
7:29 - #6: Go there first
9:06 - A challenge for you
9:49 - The fastest way to level up your charisma
